summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.92. Confirmed account takeover pattern for privileged lab-admin account s.demir@aegean.edu. All sign-ins originate from Cloudvault VPS IP 45.142.10.9 (Frankfurt, DE) via the flagged vulnerable appliance vpn-edge-01 — a geolocational and infrastructure anomaly for an Aegean University account. A single MFA approval at 21:31 is followed by seven consecutive MFA-free successes alternating between portal and LMS with no device_id recorded, consistent with MFA bypass/session hijacking through the compromised VPN appliance. The account is privileged (lab-admin), the access is repeated and automated across multiple applications, and there is no explaining context for the foreign VPS or vulnerable-appliance vector. Containment is warranted: disable the account, reset credentials, revoke sessions, and investigate the vpn-edge-01 appliance.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
